root_cause.description: The former custom-ID remap loaded the obsolete stock silhouette for redesigned commanders. Scenario 13's Royal Horse cache was adjacent but did not overwrite Elwin or Hein.
root_cause.fix: Every dense custom sprite ID 0x53AD..0x53E1 now indexes a private 0x40-byte gray source. Redesigned shapes derive a three-tone mask from the accepted custom active frame; pure recolors retain their stock hand-authored mask.

runtime.save_format: Genesis Plus GX 64 KiB interleaved SRAM

phalanx.probe_status_note: Historical evidence only. Its command window covered part of the active sprite, so it did not prove that a complete on-map unit referenced all four verified active-cache tiles. The B1.0.5 cold-boot probe below supersedes that visibility claim.

release_b105_cold_boot_revalidation.reported_symptom: Elwin appeared as red enemy infantry and his Phalanx mercenaries appeared as Royal Horse while the user identified the running ROM as B1.0.5.

exact_user_sram_cold_boot.route: Fresh isolated emulator, import the 64 KiB user SRAM, in-game load slot 1, Scenario 13, hire two Phalanx, automatic deployment, close the command window.

strengthened_formal_probe.validation_change: The active-map verifier now closes the command window and requires all four tiles of at least one actual Plane A sprite. Window/UI tile hits and partial sprites cannot satisfy the gate.

release_b105_cold_boot_revalidation.diagnosis: The exact B1.0.5 ROM and SRAM do not reproduce the attached wrong colored sprites after a cold boot. The screenshot is consistent with loading an older emulator savestate or automatic state whose VRAM and Plane A tile references predate B1.0.5. Savestates are not compatible evidence across ROM builds; use a full core restart and the in-game START -> load path.

remaining_gate: Capture Hein after a real committed move under the exact released B1.0.5 ROM. If the user can reproduce the wrong colored Elwin/Phalanx after a full RetroArch core restart and in-game SRAM load with no state or auto-state load, retain that exact B1.0.5 state for comparison; the current cold-boot B1.0.5 replay passes.
